--Orbit-Gradient has no value: its paint style is gradient_linear, which neither core nor Figma wrote as CSS here; take its look from a screenshot of a layer that uses it.
#FF6B3D is written raw once (color of 54:457) and equals --color-accent: use the token.
#E1E5EE is written raw once (background of 54:458) and equals --color-line: use the token.
1 layer keeps Figma's default name (54:458 "Rectangle 1"): name it by its role in the code.
A frame has no auto layout, so its children are placed absolutely (54:434 "Customers" with 12 children): build them as a flow if they are meant to resize.

line-height normal is Figma's Auto line height: the font's own spacing, about 1.2× the font size for most fonts (54:436 "Trusted"; 54:457 "★★★★★"); give it in px where the build must match to the pixel (inspect shows each text's).
